claims: OpenClaw is an open-source autonomous AI agent.
OpenClaw is designed to run locally.
OpenClaw connects large language models like GPT-5 or Claude directly to user files, browsers, and applications.
OpenClaw automates complex tasks such as managing emails, scheduling, and coding.
OpenClaw performs actions on the user's behalf such as buying, browsing, and executing scripts.
OpenClaw performs actions often via messaging platforms like Telegram or WhatsApp.
OpenClaw operates locally to read/write files and control software.
OpenClaw is supported on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
OpenClaw has options for self-hosting on a VPS or Raspberry Pi.
As described on Reddit, OpenClaw can be manipulated if it acts on malicious external input.
OpenClaw was formerly known as Clawdbot and Moltbot.
OpenClaw was moved to an open-source foundation after Peter Steinberger joined OpenAI.
NVIDIA's NemoClaw is being added as noted in the NVIDIA Newsroom.
